The '''2026 Retro League Event 1''' was the first event of the [[2026 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (1 February – 15 March 2026), played in [[Premiere - Hoth]] format.<ref name="t86468" /> [[Ian Monteith]] won.<ref name="pc2026e1" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 1 February – 15 March 2026
* '''Players:''' 77 (paired in at least one game)
* '''Winner:''' [[Ian Monteith]]

== Top 10 ==
The Players Committee report says the final Event 1 standings double as the cumulative league standings (3 points per win, 1 per loss, plus 4 for first and 2 for second) and lists the top ten. Players on equal points share a place; places 11 and below were not posted.<ref name="pc2026e1" />
